exposure: child's risk of asthma exacerbation (high vs low)
cohort: Caregivers (N=394) of children with asthma residing in the United States.
finding: Caregivers of children with high risk of asthma exacerbation expressed higher interest in all intervention programs and delivery methods; however, regardless of risk status, caregivers most preferred programs focused on increasing self-management skills, financial assistance, and school collaboration, and delivery methods allowing personal control over information access.
cross-section timing: At the time of the web-based survey administration, with risk of exacerbation classified based on the preceding 3 months.
